$description: 視点レンズ visual tokens v1.0. One file read by the web trainer (CSS variables), the Shorts renderer (SVG) and the Typst book. Rule: every distinction must survive black-and-white print, so trap vs lens is carried by line weight, dash and tint first, and by hue only as a bonus.

paper.note: warm off-white on screen, plain white in print

ink.note: one muted ink for all trap scratchwork

flag.note: time-cost and stall markers; never relies on red alone

lens.note: One accent per lens. On paper every lens renders as 100% black at lens weight plus its icon; hue is screen and video only.

stroke.unit: pt in print, px at 1x on screen; video renders at 2x

lens.note: heaviest line on any page; marks the breakthrough

lens_construction.note: the enclosing box, cut line, axis

type.note: Klee One only for trap scratchwork, so the left page reads as an honest student's hand, not a mistake. All three are open licences (SIL OFL).
type.note_screen: On iPad, multiply the scale by 1.25 and never go below 16px for anything a child must read.

time_cost.description: The time strip on every trap/lens pair. Same component in book, trainer and Short.
time_cost.note: Always show the source badge. Estimates are replaced by tester medians before the book ships.

book.trim: B5 portrait (182 × 257 mm) if offered on Amazon.co.jp KDP; confirm trim list before setup

spring.note: Remotion spring() for pops (labels, answer); lines and fills use easing

motion.reduce_motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion: show end states with 200 ms fades

themes.$description: Overrides layered on the base tokens. A theme lists only what it changes; everything else falls back to the base value. Chosen with the scene's `theme` prop.

short_dark.use: Shorts only. The trainer and the book stay on the base (light) theme.

paper.note: deep navy, not black: dark without feeling frightening to children

ink.note: dull chalk grey for the trap route

enclose.note: brilliant cyan when the lens activates

glow.applies_to: lens construction lines and the isolated core outline
glow.note: SVG feGaussianBlur; pulse computed from the frame, never from a timer

short_dark.missing_lens_colour: A lens with no dark value here uses its base value; add one before that lens gets a Short.
